purpose: Per AROC §4. Extends aria-research.mjs LIBRARY with 51 net-new operational state codes mapped to KB-agent's 136-article bundle. OPS imports this into the research agent's STATE_PATTERNS + LIBRARY maps.
merge_policy: additive — never overwrite existing entries in aria-research.mjs LIBRARY. If a state already exists there, this file's entry is informational only (KB mapping).

M365.OUTLOOK.OUTBOX.pattern: \b(outbox stuck|email stuck|stuck in outbox|outbox not sending|email won.?t send|sending forever|attachment too large)\b
M365.OUTLOOK.OUTBOX.title: Outlook stuck in Outbox — email won't send
M365.OUTLOOK.OUTBOX.to_human: Email pending in Outbox folder. Causes: oversized attachment, offline mode, password expired, profile corrupted.

M365.TEAMS.AUDIO.MEETING.pattern: \b(cant hear (in )?teams|teams (no )?audio|teams mic|teams cant be heard|teams meeting audio)\b
M365.TEAMS.AUDIO.MEETING.title: Teams meeting — can't hear or be heard
M365.TEAMS.AUDIO.MEETING.to_human: Teams call audio failure. Causes: device selection wrong in Teams, OS mic permission off, hardware mute on, Bluetooth profile flip.

M365.SHAREDMBX.SEND.pattern: \b(shared mailbox.*(cant|won.?t) send|send as (denied|failed)|cant send (as|from) shared|send on behalf)\b
M365.SHAREDMBX.SEND.title: Shared mailbox can read but can't send
M365.SHAREDMBX.SEND.to_human: User has access to shared mailbox but Send As / Send on Behalf permission missing or stale.

M365.LICENSE.INVALID.pattern: \b(license isn.?t valid|product is unlicensed|office activation|word excel greyed|subscription expired|cant verify office)\b
M365.LICENSE.INVALID.title: M365 license invalid / features greyed out
M365.LICENSE.INVALID.to_human: Office app activation failure. Causes: cached stale credentials, license unassigned, sign-in needs refresh.

CAM.LOCKED.BY.APP.pattern: \b(camera in use|camera being used|cant access camera|webcam locked|another app.*camera)\b
CAM.LOCKED.BY.APP.title: Camera locked by another app
CAM.LOCKED.BY.APP.to_human: Camera held by Teams/Zoom/browser tab/Snap Camera background process. Release lock + retry in new app.

CAM.VIRTUAL.BG.FAIL.pattern: \b(virtual background|background blur|background filter|background not working|cant change background|teams background|zoom background)\b
CAM.VIRTUAL.BG.FAIL.title: Virtual background not working in Teams/Zoom
CAM.VIRTUAL.BG.FAIL.to_human: Virtual background fails. Causes: hardware below spec, GPU accel off, app permissions missing, poor lighting.

BT.HANDSHAKE.FAIL.pattern: \b(airpods (wont|cant) connect|bluetooth paired not connected|headphones connected no sound|bluetooth keeps disconnecting|bluetooth reconnect)\b
BT.HANDSHAKE.FAIL.title: Bluetooth headset paired but won't connect
BT.HANDSHAKE.FAIL.to_human: Bluetooth pairing exists but connection fails. Causes: profile flip (HFP vs A2DP), pairing memory full, hardware reset needed.

AUDIO.MTG.WRONG.DEVICE.pattern: \b(wrong (mic|microphone|speaker)|cant be heard.*meeting|mic not working in meeting|audio device meeting)\b
AUDIO.MTG.WRONG.DEVICE.title: Meeting picked wrong mic or speaker
AUDIO.MTG.WRONG.DEVICE.to_human: Meeting app device selection points to wrong endpoint. Fix in app's device settings.

ZOOM.START.FAIL.title: Zoom won't start / black screen
ZOOM.START.FAIL.to_human: Zoom launch failure. Causes: GPU accel conflict, camera/screen-recording permission missing, conflicting apps, stale install.

SLACK.VOICE.JOIN.FAIL.pattern: \b(slack huddle (wont|cant)|cant join slack call|discord voice not working|slack audio missing|huddle no sound)\b
SLACK.VOICE.JOIN.FAIL.title: Slack / Discord huddle won't connect
SLACK.VOICE.JOIN.FAIL.to_human: Voice chat join fails. Causes: app mic/cam permission, RTC server unreachable, other app holding mic, region setting wrong.

NOTIF.MISSING.pattern: \b(missed notifications?|not getting (notified|pinged)|teams notifications? off|slack quiet|missed teams ping)\b
NOTIF.MISSING.title: Missing notifications — Teams/Slack/Outlook
NOTIF.MISSING.to_human: Notifications not arriving. Causes: OS Focus/DND on, app notif settings off, presence is Away, battery optimization aggressive (Android).

AUT.LOCKOUT.AFTER.PWCHG.pattern: \b(locked out after password change|account keeps locking|phone (keeps|still) asks?(ing)? for old password|sync new password)\b
AUT.LOCKOUT.AFTER.PWCHG.title: Locked out after password change
AUT.LOCKOUT.AFTER.PWCHG.to_human: One device still using old password locks account on each retry. Common: phone email, VPN, browser cache, Outlook desktop.

AUT.ACCOUNT.STATE.title: Sign-in error — disabled vs locked vs expired
AUT.ACCOUNT.STATE.to_human: Sign-in rejected. Disabled = admin action. Locked = retry threshold hit. Expired = rotate password. Blocked = Conditional Access.

AUT.SSO.LOOP.pattern: \b(sso (loop|loops|redirect loop)|saml loop|sign-in bouncing|too many redirects|okta redirect|microsoft login loop)\b
AUT.SSO.LOOP.title: SSO sign-in keeps redirecting
AUT.SSO.LOOP.to_human: SAML/OAuth loops between IdP and app. Causes: stale cookies, blocked third-party cookies, extension interference, clock drift.

MFA.LOST.AUTHENTICATOR.title: Lost authenticator phone — recover MFA
MFA.LOST.AUTHENTICATOR.to_human: Authenticator unavailable. Recovery: backup codes, alternate verification (SSPR), or admin reset.

DISPLAY.SCALE.WRONG.title: Monitor blurry / wrong scaling
DISPLAY.SCALE.WRONG.to_human: Display rendering wrong. Causes: not at native resolution, scaling % mismatch across monitors, DPI-unaware app.

DISPLAY.NOT.DETECTED.pattern: \b(external monitor not detected|second monitor not working|monitor not showing|cant detect display)\b
DISPLAY.NOT.DETECTED.title: External monitor not detected
DISPLAY.NOT.DETECTED.to_human: Monitor not recognized by OS. Causes: cable, port, driver, OS display detection cache.

KBD.LAYOUT.WRONG.pattern: \b(keyboard typing wrong|wrong characters|@ types as|keyboard language|input language|azerty)\b
KBD.LAYOUT.WRONG.title: Keyboard typing wrong characters
KBD.LAYOUT.WRONG.to_human: Input language switched accidentally (Win+Space or Cmd+Space hotkey). Switch back or remove unused languages.

INPUT.DEAD.pattern: \b(keyboard not working|mouse not working|keyboard dead|mouse frozen|no input)\b
INPUT.DEAD.title: Keyboard / mouse not responding
INPUT.DEAD.to_human: USB/Bluetooth input device unresponsive. Try different USB port, fresh batteries, reseat dongle, reboot.

PRT.NOT.FOUND.pattern: \b(printer not found|cant find printer|network printer missing|add printer (empty|nothing)|printer disappeared)\b
PRT.NOT.FOUND.title: Can't find printer in list
PRT.NOT.FOUND.to_human: Network printer not appearing in Add Printer flow. Add by IP from printer's network config page.

PRT.SLEEP.OFFLINE.pattern: \b(printer offline after (sleep|wake|reboot)|printer disconnected after|use printer offline|printer ip changed)\b
PRT.SLEEP.OFFLINE.title: Printer offline after PC wake / reboot
PRT.SLEEP.OFFLINE.to_human: Printer marked offline due to spooler crash or IP change. Restart spooler service or re-add by current IP.

VPN.CONNECTED.NO.ACCESS.pattern: \b(vpn connected (but )?(cant|no) (reach|access)|cant reach intranet|file share not accessible vpn|vpn (no )?(dns|resources))\b
VPN.CONNECTED.NO.ACCESS.title: VPN connected but can't reach intranet
VPN.CONNECTED.NO.ACCESS.to_human: Tunnel up but DNS resolution / routing broken. Test internal ping, flush DNS, check split-tunnel config.

VPN.SLOW.title: VPN connected but slow
VPN.SLOW.to_human: VPN throttle. Causes: TCP-over-TCP, distant gateway, full-tunnel routing big traffic, AV inspection.

NET.ETH.UNIDENT.title: Ethernet 'Unidentified network'
NET.ETH.UNIDENT.to_human: DHCP didn't respond. APIPA address assigned (169.254). Renew IP or fix link layer.

NET.WIFI.CONNECTED.NO.NET.pattern: \b(wifi connected (but )?no internet|no internet secured|limited connectivity|connected without internet|captive portal)\b
NET.WIFI.CONNECTED.NO.NET.title: Wi-Fi connected but no internet
NET.WIFI.CONNECTED.NO.NET.to_human: Wi-Fi link up, no internet. Causes: captive portal not accepted, DHCP/DNS issue, ISP outage, clock drift breaking SSL.

NET.INT.NONE.pattern: \b(no internet at all|internet down|cant reach any (site|web)|nothing loading)\b
NET.INT.NONE.title: No internet at all
NET.INT.NONE.to_human: Total internet loss. Check router, ISP, physical cable, restart sequence.

NET.INT.INTERMITTENT.title: Internet drops intermittently
NET.INT.INTERMITTENT.to_human: Connection drops periodically. Check signal strength, channel interference, router uptime, power saving on adapter.

SYNC.ONEDRIVE.PAUSED.title: OneDrive sync paused / stuck
SYNC.ONEDRIVE.PAUSED.to_human: OneDrive sync halted. Causes: metered network setting, single bad file blocking queue, account auth stale.

SYNC.ONEDRIVE.KFM.pattern: \b(known folder move|kfm|desktop (not )?(syncing|in onedrive)|documents not in onedrive|protect your folders)\b
SYNC.ONEDRIVE.KFM.title: OneDrive Known Folder Move issues
SYNC.ONEDRIVE.KFM.to_human: Desktop/Documents/Pictures redirection failure. Files moved to OneDrive\Desktop etc but sync state inconsistent.

SYNC.ONEDRIVE.PATH.pattern: \b(path too long|file name (too|contains)|cannot sync file|invalid character.*file|400 character)\b
SYNC.ONEDRIVE.PATH.title: OneDrive can't sync — path too long or illegal chars
SYNC.ONEDRIVE.PATH.to_human: File blocked from sync by Windows path rules. Rename to remove illegal chars or shorten path.

SYNC.CLOUD.PHONE.pattern: \b(icloud (sync|photos) stuck|google photos backup waiting|onedrive mobile stuck|photos not uploading)\b
SYNC.CLOUD.PHONE.title: Phone cloud sync stuck (iCloud / Google / OneDrive mobile)
SYNC.CLOUD.PHONE.to_human: Mobile cloud sync stalled. Causes: Wi-Fi-only setting, storage full, background permission killed, clock skew.

FILE.RECOVERY.pattern: \b(deleted file|recover file|file gone|where did my file go|onedrive recycle)\b
FILE.RECOVERY.title: Recover a deleted file
FILE.RECOVERY.to_human: Recover deleted file from local Recycle Bin, OneDrive Recycle Bin, Version history, or restore point.

FILE.LOCKED.OFFICE.pattern: \b(file (is )?locked for editing|cant open (excel|word|powerpoint)|file is in use|protected view|file format not valid|file is corrupt)\b
FILE.LOCKED.OFFICE.title: Office file won't open
FILE.LOCKED.OFFICE.to_human: Word/Excel/PowerPoint file inaccessible. Causes: real co-author lock, stale ~$ lock file, corruption, Protected View.

FILE.SHARED.NOACCESS.title: Can't open a shared file
FILE.SHARED.NOACCESS.to_human: Shared link gives access denied. Causes: wrong account signed in, link type mismatch, sharing scope too narrow, Conditional Access.

MAIL.MOBILE.SETUP.pattern: \b(setup (work )?(email|mail) on phone|outlook mobile setup|work email on (iphone|android))\b
MAIL.MOBILE.SETUP.title: Set up work email on phone
MAIL.MOBILE.SETUP.to_human: Configure work mail on iOS/Android. Outlook app preferred for M365; native Mail also works.

DEVICE.NEW.SETUP.pattern: \b(new laptop|first time setup|fresh windows|new device setup|just got a (laptop|computer))\b
DEVICE.NEW.SETUP.title: New device first-boot setup
DEVICE.NEW.SETUP.to_human: Fresh laptop initial config: sign-in, M365, OneDrive, VPN, browser, apps, security.

DEVICE.LOST.STOLEN.title: Lost or stolen company device
DEVICE.LOST.STOLEN.to_human: Device missing. Immediate: remote wipe via Intune, revoke sessions in Entra, change password, file ticket.

SOFT.INSTALL.REQUEST.pattern: \b(install (software|app)|i need (software|app)|how do I install|software installation request)\b
SOFT.INSTALL.REQUEST.title: Software installation request
SOFT.INSTALL.REQUEST.to_human: User needs new software. Route via Software Center / Company Portal or open ticket for IT approval.

SOFT.INSTALL.BLOCKED.pattern: \b(cant install|administrator privileges required|smartscreen blocked|cant run on your pc|cannot be opened.*verified)\b
SOFT.INSTALL.BLOCKED.title: Software install blocked
SOFT.INSTALL.BLOCKED.to_human: Install blocked by UAC, SmartScreen, Gatekeeper, or architecture mismatch. Diagnose by error wording.

CONF.AV.ROOM.title: Conference room AV not working
CONF.AV.ROOM.to_human: Boardroom display/audio failure. Source select, HDMI handshake, room PC sign-in, cable check.

CAL.OOO.SETUP.pattern: \b(set up out of office|configure ooo|how to set ooo|vacation responder setup)\b
CAL.OOO.SETUP.title: Set up out of office
CAL.OOO.SETUP.to_human: OOO/auto-reply setup. Outlook File → Automatic Replies. Set internal + external text + date range.

CAL.INVITE.MISSING.pattern: \b(meeting invite (missing|not received)|cant find calendar event|duplicate meeting|event shows twice|meeting on wrong calendar)\b
CAL.INVITE.MISSING.title: Meeting invite missing or duplicating
CAL.INVITE.MISSING.to_human: Calendar event issue. Check spam folder, account routing, duplicate cal subscription, shared cal sync.

CAL.OUTLOOK.GENERIC.title: Outlook calendar generic issues
CAL.OUTLOOK.GENERIC.to_human: Outlook calendar misbehaving. Repair profile, force sync, recreate view.

MFA.SETUP.title: Set up MFA / authenticator
MFA.SETUP.to_human: First-time MFA enrollment. aka.ms/mfasetup or vendor-specific (Okta Verify, Duo, Authy, etc.).

BROWSER.LOAD.FAIL.pattern: \b(pages (not |wont )?(load|loading)|browser stuck|cant reach (any|some) sites|connection timed out browser)\b
BROWSER.LOAD.FAIL.title: Browser pages not loading
BROWSER.LOAD.FAIL.to_human: Browser can't load pages. DNS, proxy, antivirus filter, extensions, profile corruption.

BROWSER.DEFAULT.REVERTS.pattern: \b(default browser keeps reverting|chrome wont stay default|edge keeps opening|links open in wrong browser|reset default browser)\b
BROWSER.DEFAULT.REVERTS.title: Default browser keeps reverting
BROWSER.DEFAULT.REVERTS.to_human: Default browser doesn't stick. Re-set in Default Apps; fix Outlook/Teams to use system default for links.

OS.WIN.UPDATE.REVERT.pattern: \b(update keeps rolling back|undoing changes|couldn.?t complete the updates|update keeps reverting|update fails repeatedly)\b
OS.WIN.UPDATE.REVERT.title: Windows Update keeps rolling back
OS.WIN.UPDATE.REVERT.to_human: Windows Update phase 2/3 failure. Disk space, driver incompatibility, .NET error, system file corruption.

OS.MAC.SPOTLIGHT.title: Mac Spotlight broken
OS.MAC.SPOTLIGHT.to_human: Spotlight index corrupted. Reindex via Privacy panel toggle or `sudo mdutil -E /`.

OS.MAC.MAIL.PWCHG.pattern: \b(mac mail not syncing|mail (wont|cant) sign in|keychain.*mail|exchange account.*mac.*password)\b
OS.MAC.MAIL.PWCHG.title: Mac Mail stopped syncing after password change
OS.MAC.MAIL.PWCHG.to_human: Keychain holds old password. Delete email server entries from Keychain Access, re-sign-in.

CLOCK.DRIFT.pattern: \b(clock (is )?wrong|time (is )?off|cert(ificate)? (date|invalid)|your connection is not private|kerberos.*clock|time sync failed)\b
CLOCK.DRIFT.title: Clock drift breaking sign-ins / SSL
CLOCK.DRIFT.to_human: System clock off real time, breaking SSL certs, Kerberos auth, and SAML tokens. Resync to NTP.

OS.WIN7.LEGACY.title: Windows 7 isolation + migration
OS.WIN7.LEGACY.to_human: Windows 7 EOL. Isolate from network until migrated; plan upgrade path.

MAC.LEGACY.STUCK.title: Older macOS stuck (10.15 etc.)
MAC.LEGACY.STUCK.to_human: Old macOS unable to upgrade. Check hardware compatibility, free space, then run Software Update.
